prompt: Do a blind review of llm_eval/live.py in llm-eval for recovery and safety defects: anything that could leave production stopped, leak a server, or misclassify a failure. List each finding with the function and why it matters. Don't change code.

solution.answer:
restore(): subprocess TimeoutExpired escapes and leaves production stopped.
Scratch server ownership is kept in memory only, so a resumed run after a crash cannot find or stop the leftover server.
The cudaMalloc failed marker is mixed-case but matched against lowercased text, and a request-time OOM is retried in place.
A failed load skips the memory-return-to-baseline gate.

followups.default: I won't be answering questions on this one; finish with your answer and change nothing.
